findings.passage: We need to vigilantly protect our right to keep an bear arms; the American people should never be helpless, defenseless victims.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, section 'The Right to Keep and Bear Arms'. Says the right to keep and bear arms should be protected.

findings.passage: The right to bear arms is a human right.  The 2nd Amendment is important in that it recognizes this human right, but our right to keep and bear arms does not come from government.
findings.note: Campaign issues page. Describes the right to bear arms as a human right that the Second Amendment recognizes.

findings.passage: We must resist the expansion of "red flag" laws, which are a dangerous slippery slope toward government obtaining the power to disarm American Citizens at will and without any semblance of due process.
findings.note: Campaign issues page. Calls for resisting red flag (extreme-risk) laws.
